4.3.2.7 Inter-ECU Response Channel Fan-Out
In the case that a SystemSignal mapped as the callSignal in a ClientServer-
ToSignalMapping fans in from multiple ISignals and the associated re-
turnSignal fans out to multiple ISignals, rather than sending any server response
to all response ISignals, the RTE shall ensure that server responses are passed to
the corresponding response ISignal based on the incoming ISignal for any given
server invocation.
A calling ISignal is mapped to the corresponding response ISignal by traversing
the model and looking at the relevant ISignalTriggerings and PhysicalChan-
nels. ISignals of the same PhysicalChannel that refer to a respective callSig-
nal need to have exactly one corresponding ISignal at the same PhysicalChan-
nel that refers to a returnSignal, where both of the SystemSignals are refer-
enced by the same ClientServerToSignalMapping.
[SWS_Rte_04694] The RTE shall unambiguously map together a call ISignal
to a response ISignal ⌈When a server runnable is configured to receive requests
from multiple callers located on different ECUs, in which the signals from all callers
fan-in to a single callSignal and the related response signals fan-out from a sin-
gle returnSignal, the RTE shall ensure that each ISignal of the same Phys-
icalChannel referring to the callSignal has exactly one corresponding ISig-
nal at the same PhysicalChannel referring to the returnSignal where both of
the SystemSignals (callSignal and returnSignal) are referenced

In the case that a SystemSignal mapped as the callSignal in a ClientServer-
ToSignalMapping fans in from multiple ISignals and the associated re-
turnSignal fans out to multiple ISignals, rather than sending any server response
to all response ISignals, the RTE shall ensure that server responses are passed to
the correct response ISignal based on the incoming ISignal for any given server
invocation.
A calling ISignal can be mapped to the correct response ISignal by traversing the
model and looking at the relevant ISignalTriggerings and PhysicalChannels.
This will associate a calling ISignal with a response ISignal, allowing an RTE to
route inter-ECU client/server responses correctly.
[SWS_Rte_04633] ⌈When a server runnable is configured to receive requests from
multiple callers located on another ECU, in which the signals from all callers fan-in to
a single SystemSignal and the related response signals fan-out from a single Sys-
temSignal, the RTE shall ensure that for any incoming call the server return values
are sent over the response ISignal based on the configuration of ISignalTrig-
gerings and PhysicalChannels.⌋
The system designer must ensure that any configuration of ISignalTriggering /
PhysicalChannel pairings which takes place in a ClientServerToSignalMap-
ping configuration chain unambiguously maps together a call ISignal to a response
